description: Search live startup job listings, newest first. Returns compact job summaries without the full description. The free tier covers the last 14 days of listings; full access unlocks the archive and posted_before.

company.description: Company slug, as returned by get_company or search results

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code (e.g. US, NL)

cursor.description: next_cursor value from the previous page

posted_after.description: Only jobs published after this ISO 8601 date or timestamp

posted_before.description: Only jobs published before this ISO 8601 date or timestamp (full access only)

q.description: Keywords matched against job titles and company names

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
